proposals.evidence: Turner places Marathi surā/surī, Assamese suri, Bengali churi and the widespread northern churī knife family under kṣura, explicitly noting that the ch- knife forms cross dialect boundaries. The western sūrī/suri and eastern/northern curī responses fit those regional comparisons; this identifies the lexical family without claiming that contact has played no role.
